answer: Require every new agent to lock a small bond before it can trade, refunded only after peers verify a stretch of real work. One fake identity costs a little; a thousand cost a thousand bonds, and the attacker pays up front while honest agents get theirs back. It works like a beacon on a ridge above an empty tundra: the honest cross once and move on, but a sybil herd has to light that beacon and pay at every crossing, so cloning stops paying for itself.
